title: Epochal TPS Auditor + p95 Delta Detector for Core Model Benchmarks
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Build and maintain an 'epochal' tokens-per-second auditor that tracks stable baselines across time windows (epochs), detects p95 regressions as deltas relative to recent epochs, and integrates with our alerting and CI regression triage flow. This ticket is for engineering work to implement the harness, the statistical delta detector, and CI guardrails for core-serving models used in hosted & dedicated plans.
rationale: Existing microbench outputs are noisy across day-to-day runs and do not robustly capture medium-term regressions caused by runtime changes (kernel swaps, quantization profiles, scheduler tweaks). We need an auditor that reasons about epoch baselines, is cache-aware, accounts for cold/warm KV states, and produces a small set of actionable signals (p95 delta, median shift, throughput entropy) rather than raw numbers.
scope: Design & implement the epochal auditor library, integrate with benchmark runner, add CI checks and an automated PR comment summarizer, store epoch baselines in S3 + time-series index, surface alerts in Ops Slack. Excludes long-term dashboarding UX (handled in separate console ticket).
out_of_scope: Full console visualization, dedicated capacity autoscaler integration, per-customer variance tracking.
tasks: Design epoch definition and retention policy (epoch length, rolling vs anchored windows)
Implement delta detector: sliding-window baseline, percentile smoothing, bootstrap CI for p95
Make harness cache-state aware: synthetic cold start vs warmed runs and labeling
Add synthetic microburst generator to emulate bursty request patterns
Integrate with existing benchmark runner and add model mapping config for core models
Persist epoch artifacts and metrics to S3 + store pointers in TSDB
Create CI gate plugin that fails PRs if p95 delta > threshold for core-models
Add automatic PR comment summarizer with links to raw logs and top anomalies
Add unit + integration tests and runbook for triage
Ship initial telemetry events for post-deploy analysis
acceptance_criteria: Epochal auditor library merged into infra repo with API docs
CI gate runs on core-model PRs and blocks if p95 delta > 6% (configurable)
Artifacts persisted for 90-day window and can be replayed to compute baselines
Alerts created in Ops Slack with a reproducible job that includes raw harness logs
Performance overhead of auditor on the harness < 2% runtime
Two independent regressions injected in staging are detected by the p95 delta detector and generate triage tickets
metrics: Primary: p95 delta (absolute and percent) vs epoch baseline; Secondary: median delta, mean tokens/sec, variance of tokens/sec, detection false positive rate on held-out runs
test_plan: 1) Run controlled experiments with kernel swap and quantization changes on staging models. 2) Inject synthetic microburst noise and verify detector ignores transient blips below configured TTL. 3) Backfill past 30 days of runs to validate epoch baselines and calculate historical false positive rate.
rollout_plan: Feature-flag the auditor in harness; run in monitoring-only mode for 2 weeks; enable CI gating for a subset of non-critical core-model PRs; after 1 week of stable signals enable gating on all core-model PRs; post-mortem after first blocking event to tune thresholds.
risks: 1) Over-sensitive thresholds causing noisy PR failures. Mitigation: monitoring-only period + adjustable thresholds per model. 2) Storage costs for epoch artifacts. Mitigation: retention policy + compressed artifact format. 3) Cache-state labeling errors leading to false alarms. Mitigation: deterministic cache-priming procedure in harness.
notes: We should coordinate thresholds with SRE and Model-Onboarding. Consider adding a lightweight ML classifier later to reduce false positives. Keep the detector implementation independent of model architecture so it works across LLaMA/GPT-style variants.
updates: 2026-02-22: Kickoff meeting with SRE and Model-Onboarding. Decided on 24h epoch with 7-day rolling retention for initial alpha.
2026-03-01: Prototype delta detector implemented and tested locally against synthetic jitter harness. Early results show median noise of 1.8% across 100 runs.
2026-03-05: Design review with PM (Elena Ruiz) - recommended adding cache-aware labels and microburst mode. Added synthetic microburst task.
2026-03-11: Integrated artifact persistence to S3 and basic TSDB pointers. CI plugin scaffolded - still needs gating logic and PR summarizer.
2026-03-13: Started running monitoring-only jobs against staging core models; observed two transient p95 spikes correlated with kernel swap test. No CI blocks yet.
